snippet.title: Mad King Redemption - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Mad King Redemption, a 2D arcade beat 'em up roguelite developed by Secret Mission. Players will serve the King the best way possible, slaying toxic enemies in his name from run to run. Take hold of a number of different classes with special abilities catering to an array of different playstyles. Mad King Redemption is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
